claim_001.label: SUPPORTED
claim_001.text: The has_read helper treats objects with a read attribute as readable even when protocol isinstance checks alone would not recognize them.

evidence.note: The helper returns true when hasattr(obj, "read") succeeds.

claim_001.rationale: The newly added helper explicitly extends readable-object detection.

claim_002.label: SUPPORTED
claim_002.text: The change was introduced to support __getattr__-based proxy objects that expose read-capable file interfaces.

evidence.note: The commit title and helper comment reference protocol checks and __getattr__-based proxies.

claim_002.rationale: The commit explicitly generalizes support for proxy objects exposing read().

claim_003.text: The change was primarily introduced to improve HTTP request throughput.
claim_003.rationale: No throughput-related goal appears in the commit or diff.
